latin: Proprium curetum est reddere opus paternae trinitatis immaculatum: mansionem primi, processum secundi, illustrationem tertii.
translation: It is the property of the Curetes to render the work of the paternal triad immaculate: the abiding of the first, the procession of the second, the illumination of the third.
